items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the first teacher for us in Detroit like Harold McKinney and, Dorothy Ashby – our first teacher was a preacher.

ctx.x: Different teachers, you know. I had teachers. I had a teacher named Mrs. Lipscum. Really, but the first teacher for us in Detroit like Harold McKinney and, Dorothy Ashby – our first teacher was a preacher. His name was Neptune Holloway. Had a heck of a name – Neptune Holloway. I remember, maybe in the ‘80s, I found out he was in Indianapolis, and I called him, and I said, “do you remember me?” I was – you know – “my mother, Bessie Harris?” or something like that. He didn’t remember, because he was of that age,…
What was the age relationship between you and those people that you just mentioned?
